How It Works

SET IT UP ONCE. DONE.

A house needs a dozen different jobs a year, and each has a right time. Most of them get skipped because nobody is keeping track.

A Property Care Plan puts all of it on one schedule with one person and one monthly price. We walk your property together, build the plan around what your home needs, and I take it from there.

✦I text you the day before every visit, and you do not need to be home
✦Billed automatically each month, with no invoices to chase
✦Rain never skips a month, the visit slides to the next dry day
✦No long contract, and materials like bulbs are billed at cost

A Sample Year

EVERY JOB IN ITS SEASON

Every visit
Cobwebs and wasp nests cleared · entry and walkways blown · dead bulbs swapped · a full walk-around · your to-do list
Winter
Windows inside and out · gutters washed out and downspouts flushed · dryer and exterior vents
Spring
AC condenser deep clean · patio and outdoor furniture cleaned · grill deep clean · pressure wash all concrete
Summer
Windows inside and out · street curb numbers repainted · exterior light fixtures cleaned · smoke and CO batteries
Fall
Pressure wash before the rain · trash cans washed out · cushions stored · gutters ready for leaf drop

This is an example. Your plan is built around your house after a walk of the property, so you only pay for what your home needs.
